subject: Orion Labs — renewal health Q&A & capacity ask
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@orionlabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Patrick Miller <patrick.miller@orionlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal health review & Q&A — Redwood usage/latency notes

Hi Logan,

Thanks for running the QBR data export for us earlier. We dug into the report (attached) and had a few items we want to raise ahead of the renewal conversation:

- Token variance: month-to-month generation tokens spiked 38% in May after a new feature shipped; embeddings usage has been steady but is now 18% of total spend.
- Performance: p95 latency for long-context calls (3k+ tokens) moved from ~420ms to ~620ms after the model upgrade last month. It's noticeable in our end-user flows.
- ROI ask: our product team needs a concise ROI recap that maps token spend to revenue (or request volume) to justify a commit uplift.

We're open to adjusting the term if there's a clear plan to stabilize latency and predict spend (e.g., model pinning + quantization recommendations). Can we schedule a 30-minute call next week to walk the QBR together and capture an action list before our procurement kickoff?

Attaching: redwood_qbr_report_May2027.pdf

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Jenkins
Head of Product
Orion Labs

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Patrick Miller <patrick.miller@orionlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal health review & Q&A — Redwood usage/latency notes

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the thorough read.  

Quick replies up front:
- We can map the generation token spike to the feature rollout and produce an ROI table (token -> API calls -> estimated revenue lift) for your procurement packet.
- On latency: that p95 regression looks correlated with the model variant change and longer prompt prefixes. Ben can run a short perf profile and propose a mitigation (pin to previous variant for long-context requests + a cache-prefetch for warm KV).
- Term/commit: we can draft a 12->18 month term that includes a staged commit uplift + a 90-day pilot at the higher commit to validate cost per 1k tokens.

Proposed next step: 30-minute review on Tue 15 Jun at 10:00am PT. If that works I will bring the ROI snapshot and an action-oriented addendum draft for SOW/DocuSign.

Attaching: usage_snapshot_202706.pdf (high-level token mix + latency breakdown)

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal health review & Q&A — Redwood usage/latency notes

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Sara's QBR notes so we can align internal asks before Tue. Key points below and my suggested go-forward: 

> On Fri, 11 Jun 2027 at 09:15 Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@orionlabs.com> wrote:
> 
> - Token variance: month-to-month generation tokens spiked 38% in May after a new feature shipped; embeddings usage has been steady but is now 18% of total spend.
> - Performance: p95 latency for long-context calls (3k+ tokens) moved from ~420ms to ~620ms after the model upgrade last month.

Internal asks: 
- Ben: can you validate the perf delta and draft two remediation options (pin old variant for long-context + KV prewarming) plus a narrow AB test plan? Keep estimated cost impact to <8% of monthly spend if possible.
- Marissa: procurement will want a clean ROI table mapping token-class to estimated $ revenue uplift (we should present 3 scenarios: conservative / expected / aggressive). Also prepare a short-term addendum template (SOW + DocuSign placeholder) for an 18-month term with a 3-month pilot at a +25% commit.

I plan to lead the Tue call and present the snapshot. If you want to pre-review the addendum, I'll circulate v1 by EOD Monday.

Thanks — LW

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@orionlabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Patrick Miller <patrick.miller@orionlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal health review & Q&A — Redwood usage/latency notes

Logan — the Tue slot worked well. Appreciate the ROI snapshot and Ben's perf notes during the review. Quick confirmation of next steps from our side: 

- We'll approve the 90-day pilot at +25% commit (finance signoff tomorrow).
- Procurement has asked for the addendum in DocuSign format — can you push the doc link and the HubSpot deal record once the internal review is complete?
- We also requested a short runbook for the long-context fallback (if p95 crosses 700ms) so our SREs know the toggle behavior.

If you can send the updated addendum and the DocuSign link today we will route for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to smoothing the renewal.

Best,
Sara
